listing.name: Poker Smash (darkuni Recomp)
listing.summary: Windows player for Poker Smash using its own Xbox 360 package.

steps.title: Prepare your original in the upstream folder
steps.instruction: Keep the Windows x64 package files together in a writable folder. Put your own Xbox 360 LIVE package for title 5841089C beside poker_smash.exe. The complete 5841089C/000D0000 console export also fits. The reviewed input uses TU 0.0.1.4.

steps.title: Use the documented Windows prerequisites
steps.instruction: The package README calls for 64-bit Windows 10 or 11 and the Microsoft Visual C++ 2015–2022 x64 Redistributable when its runtime libraries are missing.

steps.title: Complete first-run setup
steps.instruction: Start poker_smash.exe in that folder and let the upstream program prepare assets. Keep your original export separately.

steps.title: Preserve the creating folder
steps.instruction: Keep the generated assets, poker_smash.toml and any game-created profile, saves or diagnostic files alongside the creating version.

warnings: The package includes recompiled game code that the project license does not cover. Portcove downloads it only from the project’s own releases. You need your own original game files.
Keep the upstream folder outside the Portcove library. Close the game and its helpers before backing up or replacing the creating runtime and its data.
